pages.text: Do not start with a long crafting chain. Reduce exposure first. Check Body and Weather, then choose actions for the biome.

pages.title: Polar desert
pages.text: Polar spawn: 1) sneak + empty-hand right-click snow. 2) collect blocks or pack four snowballs. 3) seal a small cavity. 4) check Room. Do not search for wood before shelter.

pages.title: Forest and tundra
pages.text: Forest: seek tree cover, collect four leaf inputs for two canopy panels. In dry cold gather grass for a cape. Wind requires walls, not just a roof.

pages.title: Heat and water
pages.text: Heat: shade, light clothing, water, less sprinting. In cold avoid getting wet and swimming. Water can chill the body even at mild air temperatures.
